text: Howard Okonjo sponsored this program at board level, and he's already seen one number -- 14 -- in the formal audit report. Mara briefs him directly, in a deliberate five-part structure, before he hears a confusing, informal mention of 19 from anywhere else.

The discrepancy, stated plainly: 14 reported by the audit, 19 reported by the automation, same access, same day. The root cause: both were accurate for what each method measured -- the gap traced to unrevoked break-glass grants from the Substation 12 outage.
The fix: the 5 stale grants were revoked. Both methods now report 14, independently confirming the gap is closed. The new risk: R-06 is in the register, with a compensating control already in place.

Mara frames this with no blame -- the audit team followed its checklist correctly. Her one recommendation: update the audit charter itself, for every Critical-tier segment, so this category of gap doesn't recur.
